hook: 2012. HSV's 6.2 LS3 vs Ford's fastest Falcon. The Ford had more grunt AND was $6k cheaper.
cta: GTS or R-SPEC? Wrong answers only 👇

stories.t: Why people still fight about it
stories.a: Naturally aspirated 6.2 pushrod V8. Simple, loud and a monster aftermarket behind it.
stories.b: Just 350 built, half of them in the Silhouette/Vixen colour scheme. Supercharged, and more power for less money.
stories.take: On paper the Ford wins. Try telling a Holden fan that.

_sources: HSV GTS E Series 3 (MY12.5) manual: Carsales research 2013 HSV GTS (price when new $82,990, LS3 6.2 V8, 325 kW, 550 Nm, 13.5 L/100km)
